threat_event: Intruder uses a subcontractor's remote-support tool at a County B or City site to reach BAS and door controllers, unlocks doors after hours, and changes HVAC
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist exploiting a vendor tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 7 OT subcontractors use their own always-on tools at 11 sites outside the broker; no company MFA, approval, or logging; flat networks at 17 sites
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-05; County B and City sites; BP-01; BP-02; BP-05
regulatory_driver: CT-S exhibit (AC-17); CT-C2 and CT-M addenda; FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(i)
existing_controls: Broker with MFA and recording for company staff at all 46 sites; customer security staff on site
treatment_plan: Move SUB-4 to SUB-7 onto the broker; remove their tools; edge firewalls accept management traffic only from the broker; weekly interim check that the tools are disabled between visits
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$4M (unsafe building conditions, emergency response, customer loss at rebid)

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts corporate IT and cloud workloads, halts the ROC and BAS clusters, and steals cardholder data and drawings for extortion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recovery of 7 of 8 clusters untested; no OT telemetry in the SIEM; 14 edge firewalls behind on firmware; flat networks at 17 sites
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-09; SYS-14; BP-01 to BP-05
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-10; CP-4; SI-4; AC-6; SC-7
regulatory_driver: CT-S exhibit (CP family); CT-C1 addendum (6-hour notice); Fla. Stat. 501.171
existing_controls: MFA for all users; EDR with 24x7 MDR; isolated write-once backups in a second region; guardrails
treatment_plan: Quarterly cluster restore tests; ransomware runbook and tabletop with counsel; OT logs to the SIEM; egress alerting on the CUI library

threat_event: Attacker or insider logs in to controllers or NVRs with manufacturer default passwords and alters programs or video
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07 found defaults on 14 of 60 sampled controllers and 2 of 12 NVRs; vault covers 31 of 46 sites; subcontractor spreadsheets hold passwords for 15 sites
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05; customer field devices; BP-05; BP-08
regulatory_driver: CT-S exhibit (IA-5); CT-C2 and CT-M addenda
existing_controls: Vault and credential injection at 31 sites
treatment_plan: Change all defaults; vault coverage for all 46 sites; commissioning check; rotate on staff exit

threat_event: Malware on a customer office network spreads to BAS and door controllers at a flat site
threat_source: Cybercriminal (commodity malware or ransomware at the customer)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 17 sites have no OT segmentation; edge firewalls pass customer traffic to controllers
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05; County B and City sites; BP-05
regulatory_driver: CT-S exhibit (SC-7); CT-C2 and CT-M addenda
existing_controls: Controllers run locally; customer IT runs endpoint protection on its own PCs
treatment_plan: OT VLANs and deny-by-default rules at the 17 sites with County B and City IT; passive sensors at those sites

threat_event: Attacker takes over an access control administrator account and exports about 41,000 cardholder records and face templates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual deprovisioning in customer tenants; semiannual reviews; tenant audit trails not monitored
existing_controls: MFA on tenant administrators; vendor SOC 2 controls
treatment_plan: Federate tenants to the identity provider; quarterly reviews; alert on bulk exports

threat_event: A BAS supervisory cluster cannot be restored within its 12-hour RTO after corruption or deletion
threat_source: Software failure, operator error, or attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only 1 of 8 clusters restore-tested (11 hours); no written cluster recovery procedure
existing_controls: Isolated write-once backups; images in the backup account
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests per cluster; recovery procedure per cluster

threat_event: A failed or tampered controller cannot be restored because no current program backup exists
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The program repository holds current backups for about 55% of controllers
existing_controls: Vendor commissioning files for newer sites
treatment_plan: Collect current programs for every controller; quarterly coverage report; hashes for integrity

threat_event: An extended IFOP outage during a hurricane activation leaves the County A EOC and other county and city buildings without manual-mode procedures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual-mode procedures exist only for federal and state sites; County A EOC has none
affected_asset_or_process: BP-03; BP-05; County A EOC; County B and City sites
regulatory_driver: CT-C1 addendum; CT-S exhibit (CP-2); C-GOVERNMENT-R01 (BTTRG 1.6.2 model)
existing_controls: Local operator workstation and on-site engineer at the EOC; controllers run locally
treatment_plan: Manual-mode procedure for the EOC by 2026-12-15, then each County A, County B, City, and school site; train field staff
exposure_estimate_usd: $300K-$1.5M (and harm to the county emergency response)

threat_event: An intrusion into BAS or access control systems goes undetected for weeks because OT and tenant activity is not monitored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAS cluster, tenant audit, and OT sensor events do not reach the SIEM; no OT detection use cases; sensors at 12 of 46 sites
existing_controls: 24x7 MDR for IT sources; passive sensors at 12 sites checked on workdays
treatment_plan: Forward BAS, tenant, and sensor events to the SIEM by 2027-01-31; OT use cases; sensors at all 46 sites by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Attacker with a stolen technician credential uses a legacy VPN profile to reach site edge firewalls without the broker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 legacy VPN profiles routed straight to site edges (revoked 2026-08-28 after P07); edge firewalls still accept management from the VPN range
existing_controls: Identity provider MFA on the VPN
treatment_plan: Edge firewalls accept management only from the broker subnet; quarterly route review

threat_event: A customer notice deadline is missed after an incident, so County A misses its own 12-hour ransomware report to the state
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 5 customer clocks (6 hours to 48 hours); 2024 IR plan IT-centric; 5 of 15 field staff did not know the reporting line
regulatory_driver: CT-C1 addendum (6 hours); CT-S exhibit (24 hours); Fla. Stat. 282.3185(5)
existing_controls: P08 notification matrix (new); General Counsel owns notices
treatment_plan: Customer notice procedure; wallet cards; tabletops with County A and the state

threat_event: A departed worker keeps administrator access in a customer tenant or keeps a GSA PIV card
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual tenant removal (6 of 25 late); 2 of 25 PIV cards returned late; transfers keep prior customer access
existing_controls: Identity provider auto-disable at termination
treatment_plan: Same-day removal across tenants; PIV return on the last day with GSA sponsor notice

threat_event: Face verification at County A rejects some groups more often than others, or exposes 1,150 face templates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Expanded from pilot to 2 entrances without assessment; no signed consent; indefinite template retention; module outside the vendor SOC 2 scope
existing_controls: Badge always required; badge plus PIN fallback
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: consent, signage, 30-day deletion, vendor terms, bias testing; no new enrollments until met

threat_event: County A expands face recognition to 1:N identification of the public in lobbies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: County request received 2026-06; no review or appeal design
existing_controls: POL-05 4.10 prohibits enabling AI features without approval
treatment_plan: The company declines to configure or operate 1:N identification; letter to County A

threat_event: Attacker exploits the unsupported OS on 9 engineering workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unsupported OS required by legacy BAS tools; no EDR; internet browsing allowed
existing_controls: Broker-only remote access; no email on these workstations
treatment_plan: Replace or isolate; block internet; vendor upgrade path

threat_event: Attacker exploits a known vulnerability in out-of-date edge firewall firmware to enter a site OT network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 of 46 edge firewalls 2 or more releases behind; no OT patch program
existing_controls: External scans of edge firewalls monthly
treatment_plan: Update the 14 firewalls; monthly firmware review against known exploited vulnerabilities

threat_event: A wrong or unauthorized BAS program or door schedule change reaches a building
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 of 25 sampled program changes lacked approval; no test or integrity check before download
existing_controls: CMMS tickets for changes
treatment_plan: Approval step in the CMMS; weekly change report; hash check before download

threat_event: Business email compromise of a program manager or finance mailbox redirects a payment or requests site access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High volume of vendor and customer payment email; MFA push fatigue possible
existing_controls: MFA with number matching; phishing simulations; call-back rule for bank changes
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for finance; dual approval for bank detail changes

threat_event: Compromise of a subcontractor's own network exposes stored site credentials and remote tools for customer OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 7 OT subcontractors not bound or reviewed; their spreadsheets hold device passwords for 15 sites
existing_controls: Security addendum with SUB-1 to SUB-3
treatment_plan: Security addendum, annual review, and broker-only access for SUB-4 to SUB-7; vault every site

threat_event: Access control SaaS outage longer than the 72-hour controller cache
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single vendor for all 4 tenants
existing_controls: Vendor RTO 4 hours, RPO 15 minutes (SOC 2); printed revoke lists
treatment_plan: Extended-outage procedure with customer security offices; contract recovery terms at renewal

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over through token theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phishing-resistant keys and just-in-time elevation already in place
existing_controls: Hardware keys; just-in-time elevation; guardrails; write-once backups
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Director; review annually

threat_event: A hurricane closes HQ and the primary ROC for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup ROC failover took 2 hours 40 minutes; staff travel to the backup ROC not planned
existing_controls: Backup ROC 200 miles away; generator at HQ; storm binders
treatment_plan: Travel and lodging plan for backup ROC staff; semiannual failover drill

threat_event: A disgruntled technician deletes controller programs or changes door schedules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared engineer accounts on 3 clusters; self-approved changes
existing_controls: Background checks; broker recording
treatment_plan: Named accounts; second-person approval; OT log review

threat_event: The backup ROC cannot take over within the 2-hour RTO when the primary ROC fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 10 backup workstations lacked current alarm console profiles in the June drill
existing_controls: Backup ROC with dual ISPs
treatment_plan: Profile sync automation; semiannual drill

threat_event: GSA CUI drawings are disclosed through email outside the CUI library
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 20 sampled CUI transfers went by email; marking not kept on copies
existing_controls: CUI library with named access; CUI training for federal staff
treatment_plan: Data loss rule on CUI markings; mailbox clean-up; refresher training

threat_event: The company releases exempt security system information in response to a public records request, or fails to produce records a customer requests
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Requests reach program managers directly
existing_controls: POL-04 routes requests to the customer custodian
treatment_plan: Records request procedure and training for program managers

threat_event: Covered video or telecommunications equipment supplied by a subcontractor is used in contract performance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Company purchases are screened; subcontractor-supplied equipment is not
existing_controls: Screening of company purchases since 2024
treatment_plan: Screen subcontractor-supplied equipment; flow down 52.204-25 and 52.204-30

threat_event: Breach at the CMMS vendor exposes FCI, site asset data, and change tickets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large data set held by one SaaS vendor
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2 reviewed (P09)
treatment_plan: 72-hour breach notice clause at renewal; cyber insurance

threat_event: A new FASCSA order covers equipment the company uses and is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly SAM.gov check in place since 2024
existing_controls: Quarterly check with a log
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Contracts Director; continue quarterly checks

threat_event: Denial-of-service against a site VPN interrupts remote monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Site circuits have provider protection; controllers run locally
existing_controls: Provider protection; local alarms
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Director

threat_event: Someone unlocks the voting equipment cage at the County A elections warehouse remotely or alters its access log before an election
threat_source: Insider or attacker with tenant administrator access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote unlock is technically possible from the tenant although the annex forbids it; tenant audit trail not monitored
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 County A tenant; elections warehouse; BP-02
existing_controls: Two-person physical access; cameras; post-election log export
treatment_plan: Remove the remote unlock capability for cage doors in the tenant before the 2026-11-03 general election; alert on any cage door command; weekly log review during election periods

threat_event: Unknown devices on County A OT networks are rogue or compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07 found 41 devices not in the CMMS; inventory reconciled only at state sites
existing_controls: Passive sensors at 6 County A sites
treatment_plan: Identify all 41 devices with County A; reconcile quarterly

threat_event: A caller posing as a vendor persuades a ROC operator to approve a remote session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broker approvals partly delegated to ROC shift leads after hours
existing_controls: Call-back rule in training
treatment_plan: Approvals only by named Building Technology managers; call-back script; quarterly vishing test

threat_event: Video analytics raises false intrusion alerts that lead to an unsafe response, or flags people unfairly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy measurement since go-live; no review of who is flagged
existing_controls: ROC operators verify on video before dispatch
treatment_plan: Monthly false-alert review; no identity linkage; P10 conditions

threat_event: Candidate ranking in the HR suite screens out qualified applicants from protected groups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feature switched on 2026-03 without review; no adverse impact testing
existing_controls: Recruiters see all applicants
treatment_plan: Suspend ranking until an adverse impact test passes (P10); human review of every rejection

threat_event: BAS fault analytics in autonomous mode changes setpoints unsafely
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Autonomous mode is offered by the vendor but disabled; advisory mode only
existing_controls: Advisory mode; technicians act on recommendations
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Controls Engineering Manager while autonomous mode stays disabled

threat_event: Staff paste drawings, door schedules, or cardholder data into a public generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Enterprise assistant approved only in pilot; public tools not blocked on all devices
existing_controls: POL-05 rules; training
treatment_plan: Approve the enterprise assistant; block public tools on managed devices

threat_event: Loss of BAS cooling control at the state data center building, by failure or attack, overheats the agency's data center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single BAS cluster path; no tested manual-mode drill since April
existing_controls: Local operator workstation; 24x7 on-site engineer; portable cooling purchase order
treatment_plan: Quarterly hand-mode drill; alarm escalation straight to the on-site engineer

threat_event: A malicious update from the access control SaaS vendor affects all 4 customer tenants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One vendor for all tenants; update testing is the vendor's
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 change management controls
treatment_plan: Ask for staged release and notice terms; monitor tenant administrator actions

threat_event: A lost technician laptop or tablet exposes cached drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Encrypted devices with remote wipe
existing_controls: Full-device encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Director

threat_event: Phishing steals a technician's credentials and MFA approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA for non-administrators; 6.9% phishing click rate
existing_controls: Number matching; broker per-session approval
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for Building Technology and ROC staff

threat_event: Unauthorized person enters the ROC and uses an unlocked console
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Separate badge zone with visitor logs and monitoring
existing_controls: Badge zone; 15-minute lock; ROC staff present 24x7
treatment_plan: Accepted by the VP Operations

threat_event: The single OT Security Engineer leaves or is unavailable during an OT incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One OT security specialist; vCISO part-time
existing_controls: Insurer panel OT responder
treatment_plan: Second OT security position in FY2027; cross-train a security analyst

threat_event: Subcontractor staff without verified background checks work unescorted at the elections warehouse or a federal building
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Company does not verify subcontractor screening
existing_controls: Customer escorts at some sites
treatment_plan: Verification of subcontractor screening before site access

threat_event: Attacker joins a legacy wireless BAS gateway at a City building using its shared key
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 gateways with a shared key installed by a prior contractor
existing_controls: Gateways sit on the flat network (no compensating control)
treatment_plan: Replace or re-key with the City; segment

threat_event: The company misses the state SOC 2 Type 2 commitment, putting the CT-S renewal at risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many controls must operate for a full period before the audit
existing_controls: Readiness assessment (P09)
treatment_plan: Remediation roadmap; Type 1 by 2027-06-30; Type 2 period 2027-07-01 to 2027-12-31

threat_event: A known-exploited vulnerability in BAS software or reader firmware stays unpatched
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No OT firmware program; ICS advisories reviewed but not tracked to closure
existing_controls: Weekly ICS advisory review
treatment_plan: Track advisories to closure in the CMMS; passive vulnerability identification

threat_event: The company acquires a contract or competitor and connects its systems without security due diligence
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PE sponsor pursuing add-on acquisitions; no integration security checklist
existing_controls: vCISO consulted informally
treatment_plan: Security due diligence and integration checklist approved by the COO

threat_event: The school district VPN connection becomes a path into the IFOP, or from the IFOP into the district
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Broker-mediated connection with no interconnection agreement
existing_controls: Broker approval and recording; district firewall
treatment_plan: Interconnection agreement; restrict the broker target list

threat_event: A cellular modem on a BAS controller panel at a City building gives an attacker a direct path to the OT network (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Modem installed by a prior contractor for remote support; not in any inventory; bypasses the edge firewall
existing_controls: None until found
treatment_plan: Remove the modem with the City (2026-10-15); sweep all City and County B panels for modems

threat_event: A subcontractor's technicians share one administrator account in the County B access control tenant (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared account; actions cannot be traced to a person
existing_controls: MFA on the shared account (one phone shared)
treatment_plan: Named accounts for each subcontractor technician; disable the shared account

threat_event: Ransomware on a customer's network reaches the company's edge firewall or broker connection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat networks at 17 sites; edge firewalls accept management from the VPN range
existing_controls: EDR on cloud servers; broker isolation
treatment_plan: Segmentation (R-004); interconnection agreements; customer incident notice to the company
